title: Baptist preacher prays over the bodies
summary: Scott Ramsay tells of Baptist preacher prays over the bodies, about March 25, 1948 at New Mexico (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And he said, "Well, I'm not Catholic. I'm a Baptist preacher, but I'd be more than happy to say a prayer over him."

plain: Scott Ramsay, who tells the story of a saucer said to have come down at Hart Canyon near Aztec, New Mexico, in March 1948, relays an account from a local preacher named Solon Brown. According to Ramsay, Brown was asked to pray over the bodies found at the site, and he answered that he wasn't Catholic, he was a Baptist preacher, but he'd be glad to say a prayer over them. If true, it would mean ordinary local people saw the bodies of beings from the craft.
